timing: CUDA graphs, preallocated plans, rotated order, warm buffers, unlocked clocks; dX uses the committed swapAB defaults in all modes; bias enabled.
measurement_vs_final_note: After measurements, the default dw_native_dy was enabled and input validation/docs were tightened. Benchmark calls explicitly select baseline/native/swap, so their measured execution paths are unchanged. The final default passed the full regression suite.

decision.default: native dY, original dW operand order
decision.reason: Cached FP8 X already feeds native B pairs without layout MOVs. SwapAB adds no consistent gain; moving dY transpose from global preparation to native BF16 LDSM removes the dY^T allocation/store.
decision.api: LinearBackwardPlan(..., dw_native_dy=True) is now default; dw_native_dy=False restores baseline; dw_swap_ab=True tests swapping dW operands. FP8Linear overall default remains Triton.
decision.removed: dY^T BF16 buffer[Np,Mp] and its write in prepare_dy; dY batch tails handled by TMA.
decision.retained: BF16 dY preparation for stride/alignment and bias partials, independent Triton X^T quantization, row/M32 scale semantics, FP32 dW output.
decision.scope: 8 native-dY tile variants plus 8 swapAB variants; two consumer warpgroups, TMA loading and FP32 TMA output; no consumer global loads.

Six performance shapes are bitwise equal for dX/dW/db across all three modes.
